title: Using Soft-Prompt Tuning to Evaluate Bias in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper mentions 'religion' as an example of a sensitive attribute but did not conduct any experiments or measurements related to it. The conducted measurements focused on bias related to age, sexuality, and disability.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as this was not an axis of evaluation in the experiments. The study focused on age, sexuality, and disability.
